name: nostos-essence
description: An 84-second NOSTOS concept film built with Remotion

scripts.stills: remotion still Scene01-Hook out/stills/scene01-hook.png --frame=97 && remotion still Scene02-Connect out/stills/scene02-connect.png --frame=112 && remotion still Scene03-Sensors out/stills/scene03-sensors.png --frame=187 && remotion still Scene04-Architecture out/stills/scene04-architecture.png --frame=202 && remotion still Scene05-Signals out/stills/scene05-signals.png --frame=202 && remotion still Scene06-Safety out/stills/scene06-safety.png --frame=217 && remotion still Scene07-Shared-State out/stills/scene07-shared-state.png --frame=172 && remotion still Scene08-Finale out/stills/scene08-finale.png --frame=120 && remotion still NostosEssence out/nostos-essence-cover.png --frame=2380
scripts.check-media: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const files=['public/captions.json','public/audio/ambient.mp3','public/audio/scene01.mp3','public/audio/scene02.mp3','public/audio/scene03.mp3','public/audio/scene04.mp3','public/audio/scene05.mp3','public/audio/scene06.mp3','public/audio/scene07.mp3','public/audio/scene08.mp3','public/sfx/rear_warning.mp3','public/sfx/speed_down_request.mp3','public/sfx/speed_up_request.mp3','public/sfx/stop_request.mp3','public/video/nostos-ride-signals.mp4'];const missing=files.filter((file)=>{try{return fs.statSync(file).size===0}catch{return true}});if(missing.length){console.error('Missing or empty media:\n'+missing.join('\n'));process.exit(1)}console.log('Media check passed: '+files.length+' files')"
